record.title: Melchor de Mencos cargo blockade, late August–2 September 2021
record.scope: Guatemala-side road approach to the Melchor de Mencos–Benque Viejo crossing
record.crossings: Melchor de Mencos / Benque Viejo Western Border
record.direction: Guatemala to Belize freight movement demonstrated; reverse and passenger effects unresolved.
record.movement: Incoming Guatemalan trucks, including non-corn cargo
record.consequences: Other freight unable to enter Belize.
record.relationship: Promoted from R15-AM-L003; distinct from AM030 national COVID passenger policy.
record.status_observation: Resumption reported on2 September2021; no present-status inference.
record.official_rationale: Hauliers opposed repeated COVID testing and custodian/taxi charges. Codes describe commercial and health-policy grievances, not an infection-control purpose of the blockade.
record.context: Separate non-state obstruction under existing pandemic border rules.
record.uncertainty: Contemporary local accounts support August31, but later roundup gives August30. Month precision preserves disagreement. Repeated blocking language leaves overnight continuity uncertain; original Customs letter unavailable.
